answer: To reset your password, go to the self-service portal and click 'Forgot password'. If your account is locked, wait 15 minutes or contact IT.
Open the VPN client, select your company server and log in with your work credentials. Restart the client if it hangs.
Turn Wi-Fi off and on, forget the network, then reconnect. If it still fails, restart your laptop.
Check the printer is on and has paper, then remove and re-add it under Settings > Printers.
Restart Outlook. If emails are not syncing, check your internet connection and try Outlook on the web.
